en.headline: Buildings Department finds One Stanley reinforcement does not match plans
en.dek: Inspectors say a beam cover and some floor slabs at a Stanley house do not follow approved drawings, though they see no obvious danger.
body: The Buildings Department said on Saturday it had found construction at a house in the One Stanley development that did not follow the approved plans, and that it would press the investigation.

The department said a wire mesh was missing from the concrete cover of a beam on the lower ground floor, and that reinforcement in some floor slabs did not match the drawings. It said the defects did not amount to an obvious danger, but that the quality of the work needed follow-up. Letters have gone to the project's authorized person, registered structural engineer, registered contractor and developer, asking them to meet officials and provide information.

The house received an occupation permit in July 2023. The department said it received a report from the owner in January this year about the structural safety of floor slabs. Staff who inspected in March considered the building as a whole to show no obvious danger, and opened an investigation. Between June and September officers carried out further site visits and tests, including rebound-hammer checks on concrete strength, cover-meter and radar surveys of reinforcement, core compression tests and opening-up inspections. Analysis of those results is continuing.

The department reminded the industry that building professionals and contractors must supervise and build in line with approved plans. It said that if the investigation finds breaches of the Buildings Ordinance, it will follow up seriously, including prosecution and or disciplinary action.

zh.headline: 屋宇署：赤柱One Stanley獨立屋鋼筋配置不符圖則
zh.dek: 署方指地面低層一條橫樑保護層未按圖則配鋼絲網，部分樓板鋼筋亦與圖則不符，但未構成明顯危險。
body: 屋宇署星期六表示，赤柱One Stanley一間獨立屋的施工與批准圖則不符，署方會繼續跟進調查。
署方公布，該屋地面低層一條橫樑的保護層沒有按圖則配置鋼絲網，部分樓板的鋼筋配置亦與圖則不符。署方指這些情況未構成明顯危險，但施工質量須要關注和跟進，已去信發展項目的認可人士、註冊結構工程師、註冊承建商及發展商，要求會面並提供資料。
該獨立屋於2023年7月獲發入伙紙。屋宇署說，今年1月接獲業主就樓板結構安全的舉報，人員3月視察後認為整體樓宇結構沒有明顯危險，並展開調查。6月至9月署方多次實地視察及檢驗，包括混凝土強度反彈錘測試、保護層測厚、雷達勘測鋼筋、鑽芯抗壓測試及開鑿檢驗，現正分析所得數據。
屋宇署提醒，建築專業人士及承建商必須按批准圖則監工和施工。若調查發現有人違反《建築物條例》，署方會嚴肅跟進，包括提出檢控及／或紀律處分。
